# Alvo

> Senior Google Ads management for European eCommerce brands — without the agency bloat.

Alvo is a performance marketing agency specialising in Google Ads for eCommerce brands operating in European markets. Founded by Rodrigo Kato, a senior performance marketer with 6+ years of experience managing multi-million euro budgets across the Netherlands, UK, Germany, and beyond.

Alvo is built on a simple premise: European eCommerce brands deserve direct access to a senior operator who takes full responsibility for their paid media — not a rotating cast of junior account managers. No handoffs. No layers. No one learning on your budget.

## What Alvo does

- Google Search Ads — intent-driven campaigns structured for eCommerce conversion
- Google Shopping & Performance Max — feed management, campaign architecture, and ongoing optimisation
- Feed automation — dynamic campaign generation at scale using tools like Channable
- Multi-market expansion — localised paid media strategy across EU markets
- Account audits — honest, no-pitch reviews of existing Google Ads accounts

## Who Alvo works with

European eCommerce brands with monthly Google Ads budgets between €5,000 and €150,000. Ideal clients are brands doing €500k–€10M in annual revenue who are serious about scaling paid revenue efficiently.

Not a fit: early-stage brands with no ad history, brands outside eCommerce, or brands looking for Meta/social-only management.

## Pricing

- Starter: €1,500/mo — Search + Shopping, up to €15k ad spend
- Growth: €2,500/mo — Full funnel, up to €50k ad spend
- Scale: €4,000/mo — Multi-market, up to €150k ad spend
- Performance model available: base fee + percentage of spend

No lock-in contracts. Month-to-month after an initial 3-month engagement.

## Credentials

- TicketSwap (Netherlands) — automated campaign coverage for 500,000 events across 36 markets; −15% unsold inventory, +60% campaign coverage, −80% time on campaign creation
- Artipoppe (Netherlands) — premium eCommerce Google Ads scaling
- LandLife (Netherlands) — multi-market European expansion
- Cornershop by Uber (LatAm/US) — −79% CAC, +17% spend scaled via dynamic creative automation
